summary: Iteration 3 testing for Sentinel Edge - Decision Feed panel and Add/Remove Ticker features. All 16 new backend tests pass, 79 regression tests pass (95/95 total). All frontend features verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In TradingOverview.tsx, the `live` prop is correctly set to `!mockMode` for DecisionFeed. When mockMode=true, Live indicator is hidden. Signal strength values also use `text-emerald-400` class which can confuse test selectors targeting the Live badge — not a bug but worth noting.
Minor: The validation regex `/^[A-Z]{1,6}$/` only allows purely letter symbols. Test case '123' correctly gets rejected with 'Enter a valid symbol (1–6 letters)' message.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all decision feed + add/remove ticker features verified)

mocked_apis: MOCKED: Decision feed entries in mock mode use generateMockDecisions() from mockData.ts. Backend /api/decisions is real and returns empty list when markets closed (expected behavior).
seed_data_creation: Added/removed TEST_TST ticker and TSLA during tests - all cleaned up via teardown_method
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 fully tested. Backend: 95/95 tests pass total (16 new in test_decision_feed_and_tickers.py + 79 regression). Frontend: Decision Feed working with correct color-coded badges (BUY=emerald, STOP=red, EXIT=red, TIGHTEN=purple, TRAIL=blue). Add/Remove ticker fully working in mock mode. Empty state placeholder shown when all tickers removed. Input validation rejects non-letter inputs. Live indicator correctly hidden in mock mode (live={!mockMode}). All 4 tabs and pause/resume still work.
